picks.title: Rethinking Purpose
picks.summary: These days, it seems like advice for how to “find your purpose” is everywhere. But what if purpose isn’t some hidden answer waiting to be found? And what if anxiously searching for our one true calling actually makes it harder to live with purpose?On this episode, we explore some other approaches to the problem. Clinical psychologist Ross White tells us about how psychological flexibility can help us form purpose over time, and stay connected to it, even as our lives change. picks.title: The Time to Live Is Now
picks.summary: This episode explores how remembering mortality can sharpen both attention and freedom.Oliver Burkeman and Alan Watts show why the present matters precisely because it cannot be repeated, while John O’Donohue and Epictetus use the same awareness to put fear, status, and authority into perspective.Life’s brevity asks us to be more present with the people we love and less willing to surrender our inner freedom to temporary pressures.
